abstract: Seventy-six patients with invasive hydatidiform mole (HM) were reviewed as to clinical course, particularly treatment and outcome, in relation to their age. The results were as follows: (i) metastatic cases showed approximately a twofold increase in patients over 40 compared with younger patients, (ii) more courses of chemotherapy were required to achieve a cure in patients over 40 than in younger patients and (iii) 4 of 19 patients (21.1%) over 40 developed choriocarcinoma, whereas none of younger patients did.
abstract_ja: 浸潤胞状奇胎(HM)の患者76例について、年齢との関係から臨床経過、特に治療と転帰を再検討した。結果は以下のとおりであった。(i) 転移例は40歳以上の患者が若年患者と比べて約2倍多かった。(ii) 40歳以上の患者では、若年患者と比べて治癒までに多くのコースの化学療法を要した。(iii) 40歳以上の19例中4例(21.1%)が絨毛癌を発症したのに対し、若年患者では絨毛癌の発症は認められなかった。
